children: On September 18, on-chain analyst Ai Yi (@ai_9684xtpa) reported that XXAntiWar cut losses on ZEC short positions twice in the past three days, losing $398,000 and giving back nearly all profits made on Hyperliquid over the past week. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, since September, she has opened eight ZEC short positions across three addresses, with five wins and three losses, a 62.5% win rate.
She has continued shorting ZEC from $1,120.8 to $1,353, while cumulative profit on the token still stands at $437,000.

title: XXAntiWar Sells ZEC Shorts Twice in Three Days, Erasing Recent Hyperliquid Gains
